description: Join us for a fundraising reception in support of Cynthia Curtin , candidate for 9th District Court of Appeals Judge . The event is hosted by Doug Deeken, Marshal Pitchford, and Greg Long and will be held in Wooster on Wednesday, September 9. Wednesday, September 9 | 5:30–7:00 PM 5
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Cynthia Curtin for Judge Committee
title: Wooster Welcomes Curtin: A Fundraiser Event — Cynthia Curtin for Judge
